function: The border-image-repeat property specifies whether the border image should be repeated, rounded, spaced or stretched.

values.function: Default value. The image is stretched to fill the area
The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area
The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the image is rescaled so it fits
The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the extra space is distributed around the tiles
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
